cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|typings|exports)"' -A3 | head -30; ls build; ls build/esm 2>/dev/null | head; ls build/esm/components | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Button/Button.d.ts | head -80; echo ====; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; echo ====; ls controls; echo ====; cat controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat controls/PasswordInput/PasswordInput.d.ts; echo ====; cat Button/types.d.ts | head -60; echo ====; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; echo ====; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|Flex\|Card\|Text\b\|Title\|Button\|Checkbox\|TextInput\|PasswordInput\|Link" index.d.ts ../index.d.ts | head -40; echo ====; cat ../../../build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ===; cat Link/Link.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n '"./styles' -A4 package.json | head -30; echo ===; cat build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -70; echo ===; ls build/esm/components/theme; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ===; grep -rn "export" build/esm/components/layout/index.d.ts | head; echo; ls build/esm/components/layout;

cat build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -30; echo ===; grep -n "Theme\b\|export type" build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts | head; echo ===; sed -n 1,80p README.md | grep -v "^$" | head -70; echo ===; head -c 600 styles/styles.css; echo; ls styles/themes
ls docs; echo ===; cat docs/theming.md | head -150; echo ===; cat docs/migration-to-v8.md | head -120

grep -n -i "theme\|ThemeProvider\|body" README.md | head -40; echo ===; grep -rn "body\|g-root" styles/styles.css | head -5; echo ===; grep -o "g-root[^{]*{[^}]*}" styles/styles.css | head -3 | cut -c1-200; echo; cat styles/fonts.css | head -15
sed -n 80,200p README.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && ls docs | head -50; echo ===; cat docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo ===; cat esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; cat esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && ls components guides | head -120; echo ===; sed -n 1,120p guides/theming.md
cat components/Checkbox.md | head -80; echo =====; ls components/controls; echo ====; cat components/controls/TextInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Button/constants.d.ts; grep -n "variant" Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "header-1\|header-2" Text/text/text.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "TextInputSize\|InputControlSize\|InputControlView" -A2 controls/types.d.ts | head -12; echo ===; cat ../../docs/components/PasswordInput.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; cat ../../docs/components/controls/PasswordInput.md | sed -n 1,60p

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout && sed -n 1,60p spacing/spacing.d.ts; echo ===; grep -n "gap\|padding\|\bp?" types.d.ts | head -20; echo ===; sed -n 1,40p Box/Box.d.ts | head -60; echo ===; grep -rn "spacing-" ../../../../docs/guides/layout.md | head -10

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && grep -n "export type Space\b\|SpacingValue\b" -A3 esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "SpacingValue =" esm/components/layout/*.d.ts | head; grep -n "spacing-" docs/guides/layout.md | head -8; grep -n "Space =" -A2 esm/components/layout/types.d.ts | head

cat esm/components/ControlLabel/ControlLabel.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls esm/components/ControlLabel 2>/dev/null; echo ===; sed -n 1,40p docs/components/ControlLabel.md 2>/dev/null; echo ===; cat esm/components/Card/Card.css | head -60; echo ===; grep -n "padding" esm/components/Card/*.css | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput && ls; grep -n "id" TextInput.js | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "Unknown env config" | tail -60

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer" ; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i "playwright\|puppeteer"; echo done

mkdir -p /tmp/pw && cd /tmp/pw && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 300 npm install playwright@1 2>&1 | tail -3 && timeout 400 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; cat /tmp/vite.log | grep -v "Unknown env" | tail -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/

(npx vite --port 5174 --strictPort > /tmp/vite2.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5174/; curl -s http://localhost:5174/src/LoginPage.tsx | head -3 | cut -c1-200
id -u; sudo -n true 2>&1 | head -1; which apt-get; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i "glib\|nss3" | head; ls /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i "libglib" | head -3
head -30 /tmp/ssr/err.log | cut -c1-300

cd /tmp/ssr && sed -i "s/ssr: { noExternal: true },/ssr: { noExternal: ['@gravity-ui\/uikit'] },/; s/const React = await server.ssrLoadModule('react');/const React = await import('react');/; s/const { renderToStaticMarkup } = await server.ssrLoadModule('react-dom\/server');/const { renderToStaticMarkup } = await import('react-dom\/server');/" ssr.mjs && grep -n "noExternal\|import('react" ssr.mjs && timeout 170 node ssr.mjs > /tmp/ssr/out.html 2>/tmp/ssr/err2.log; echo "exit=$?"; grep -v "npm warn" /tmp/ssr/err2.log | head -20 | cut -c1-300; wc -l /tmp/ssr/out.html; grep -n "<label\|<input\|<button\|<h1\|Запомнить" /tmp/ssr/out.html | cut -c1-200 | head -30

pkill -f "vite --port 5174" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rm -rf dist && git status --short && echo --- && git diff --stat && echo --- && npm audit --json 2>/dev/null | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(j.metadata.vulnerabilities);for(const [n,v] of Object.entries(j.vulnerabilities)) console.log(v.severity, n, v.isDirect?"direct":"transitive", (v.via||[]).filter(x=>typeof x==="object").map(x=>x.title).slice(0,2).join(" | "))})'

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"vite --port 5174"*) echo "killing ${p#/proc/}: $cmd"; kill ${p#/proc/} ;; esac; done; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "5174 -> %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5174/ || true
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "5174: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5174/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "5173: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short
